animations:workspace_wraparound.desc: changes the direction of slide animations between the first and last workspaces

binds:allow_pin_fullscreen.desc: Allows fullscreen to pinned windows, and restore their pinned status afterwards

binds:allow_workspace_cycles.desc: If enabled, workspaces don't forget their previous workspace.

binds:disable_keybind_grabbing.desc: If enabled, apps that request keybinds to be disabled will not be able to do so.

binds:drag_threshold.desc: Movement threshold in pixels for window dragging and c/g bind flags. 0 to disable.

binds:focus_preferred_method.desc: sets the preferred focus finding method when using focuswindow/movewindow/etc with a direction.

binds:hide_special_on_workspace_change.desc: If enabled, changing the active workspace will hide the special workspace on the monitor.

binds:ignore_group_lock.desc: If enabled, dispatchers like moveintogroup, moveoutofgroup and movewindoworgroup will ignore lock per group.

binds:movefocus_cycles_fullscreen.desc: If enabled, when on a fullscreen window, movefocus will cycle fullscreen.

binds:movefocus_cycles_groupfirst.desc: If enabled, when in a grouped window, movefocus will cycle windows in the groups first.

binds:pass_mouse_when_bound.desc: if disabled, will not pass the mouse events to apps / dragging windows around if a keybind has been triggered.

binds:scroll_event_delay.desc: in ms, how many ms to wait after a scroll event to allow passing another one for the binds.

binds:window_direction_monitor_fallback.desc: If enabled, moving a window or focus over the edge of a monitor with a direction will move it to the next monitor.

binds:workspace_back_and_forth.desc: If enabled, an attempt to switch to the currently focused workspace will instead switch to the previous workspace.

binds:workspace_center_on.desc: Whether switching workspaces should center the cursor on the workspace (0) or on the last active window (1)

cursor:default_monitor.desc: the name of a default monitor for the cursor to be set to on startup

cursor:hide_on_key_press.desc: Hides the cursor when you press any key until the mouse is moved.

cursor:hide_on_tablet.desc: Hides the cursor when the last input was a tablet input until a mouse input is done.

cursor:hide_on_touch.desc: Hides the cursor when the last input was a touch input until a mouse input is done.

cursor:hotspot_padding.desc: the padding, in logical px, between screen edges and the cursor

cursor:inactive_timeout.desc: in seconds, after how many seconds of cursor's inactivity to hide it. Set to 0 for never.

cursor:min_refresh_rate.desc: minimum refresh rate for cursor movement when no_break_fs_vrr is active.

cursor:no_break_fs_vrr.desc: disables scheduling new frames on cursor movement for fullscreen apps with VRR enabled.

cursor:no_warps.desc: if true, will not warp the cursor in many cases

cursor:persistent_warps.desc: When a window is refocused, the cursor returns to its last position relative to that window.

cursor:use_cpu_buffer.desc: Makes HW cursors use a CPU buffer.

cursor:warp_back_after_non_mouse_input.desc: warp the cursor back to where it was after using a non-mouse input to move it.

cursor:warp_on_change_workspace.desc: Move the cursor to the last focused window after changing the workspace.

cursor:warp_on_toggle_special.desc: Move the cursor to the last focused window when toggling a special workspace.

cursor:zoom_detached_camera.desc: Detaches the camera from the mouse when zoomed in

cursor:zoom_disable_aa.desc: If enabled, when zooming, no antialiasing will be used

cursor:zoom_factor.desc: the factor to zoom by around the cursor. 1 means no zoom.

cursor:zoom_rigid.desc: whether the zoom should follow the cursor rigidly or loosely

debug:colored_stdout_logs.desc: enables colors in the stdout logs.

debug:damage_tracking.desc: redraw only the needed bits of the display.

debug:disable_scale_checks.desc: disables verification of the scale factors.

debug:ds_handle_same_buffer.desc: Special case for DS with unmodified buffer

debug:ds_handle_same_buffer_fifo.desc: Special case for DS with unmodified buffer unlocks fifo

debug:error_limit.desc: limits the number of displayed config file parsing errors.

debug:error_position.desc: sets the position of the error bar.

debug:fifo_pending_workaround.desc: Fifo workaround for empty pending list

debug:full_cm_proto.desc: claims support for all cm proto features (requires restart)

debug:gl_debugging.desc: enable OpenGL debugging and error checking.

debug:manual_crash.desc: set to 1 and then back to 0 to crash Hyprland.

debug:render_solitary_wo_damage.desc: Render solitary window with empty damage

debug:suppress_errors.desc: if true, do not display config file parsing errors.

debug:vfr.desc: controls the VFR status of Hyprland. Do not turn off unless debugging

decoration:blur:ignore_opacity.desc: make the blur layer ignore the opacity of the window

decoration:blur:input_methods.desc: whether to blur input methods (e.g. fcitx5)

decoration:blur:input_methods_ignorealph.desc: works like ignorealpha in layer rules. If pixel opacity is below set value, will not blur.

decoration:blur:new_optimizations.desc: whether to enable further optimizations to the blur.

decoration:blur:passes.desc: the amount of passes to perform

decoration:blur:popups.desc: whether to blur popups (e.g. right-click menus)

decoration:blur:popups_ignorealpha.desc: works like ignorealpha in layer rules. If pixel opacity is below set value, will not blur.

decoration:blur:special.desc: whether to blur behind the special workspace (note: expensive)

decoration:blur:vibrancy_darkness.desc: How strong the effect of vibrancy is on dark areas.

decoration:blur:xray.desc: if enabled, floating windows will ignore tiled windows in their blur.

decoration:border_part_of_window.desc: whether the border should be treated as a part of the window.

decoration:dim_around.desc: how much the dimaround window rule should dim by.

decoration:dim_modal.desc: enables dimming of parents of modal windows

decoration:dim_special.desc: how much to dim the rest of the screen by when a special workspace is open.

decoration:dim_strength.desc: how much inactive windows should be dimmed

decoration:glow:color.desc: glow's color. Alpha dictates glow's opacity.

decoration:glow:color_inactive.desc: inactive glow color. (if not set, will fall back to decoration:glow:color)

decoration:glow:render_power.desc: in what power to render the falloff (more power, the faster the falloff)

decoration:motion_blur:enabled.desc: enable motion blur for moving and resizing windows

decoration:motion_blur:samples.desc: amount of samples used for motion blur

decoration:rounding_power.desc: rounding power of corners (2 is a circle)

decoration:screen_shader.desc: a path to a custom shader to be applied at the end of rendering.

decoration:shadow:color.desc: shadow's color. Alpha dictates shadow's opacity.

decoration:shadow:color_inactive.desc: inactive shadow color. (if not set, will fall back to col.shadow)

decoration:shadow:render_power.desc: in what power to render the falloff (more power, the faster the falloff)

decoration:shadow:sharp.desc: whether the shadow should be sharp or not.

dwindle:default_split_ratio.desc: the default split ratio on window open.

dwindle:force_split.desc: force a split direction for new windows

dwindle:permanent_direction_override.desc: if enabled, makes the preselect direction persist.

dwindle:precise_mouse_move.desc: if enabled, bindm movewindow will drop the window more precisely depending on where your mouse is.

dwindle:preserve_split.desc: if enabled, the split will not change regardless of what happens to the container.

dwindle:smart_resizing.desc: if enabled, resizing direction will be determined by the mouse's position on the window.

dwindle:smart_split.desc: if enabled, allows a more precise control over the window split direction based on the cursor's position.

dwindle:special_scale_factor.desc: specifies the scale factor of windows on the special workspace

dwindle:split_bias.desc: specifies which window will receive the split ratio.

dwindle:use_active_for_splits.desc: whether to prefer the active window or the mouse position for splits

ecosystem:no_donation_nag.desc: disable the popup that shows up twice a year encouraging to donate.

ecosystem:no_update_news.desc: disable the popup that shows up when you update hyprland to a new version.

general:allow_tearing.desc: master switch for allowing tearing to occur.

general:border_size.desc: size of the border around windows

general:col.active_border.desc: border color for the active window

general:col.nogroup_border.desc: inactive border color for window that cannot be added to a group

general:col.nogroup_border_active.desc: active border color for window that cannot be added to a group

general:extend_border_grab_area.desc: extends the area around the border where you can click and drag on, only used when general:resize_on_border is on.

general:float_gaps.desc: gaps between windows and monitor edges for floating windows

general:gaps_out.desc: gaps between windows and monitor edges

general:gaps_workspaces.desc: gaps between workspaces. Stacks with gaps_out.

general:hover_icon_on_border.desc: show a cursor icon when hovering over borders, only used when general:resize_on_border is on.

general:modal_parent_blocking.desc: if true, parent windows of modals will not be interactive.

general:no_focus_fallback.desc: if true, will not fall back to the next available window when moving focus in a direction where no window was found

general:resize_corner.desc: force floating windows to use a specific corner when being resized (1-4 going clockwise from top left, 0 to disable)

general:resize_on_border.desc: enables resizing windows by clicking and dragging on borders and gaps

general:snap:border_overlap.desc: if true, windows snap such that only one border's worth of space is between them

general:snap:monitor_gap.desc: minimum gap in pixels between window and monitor edges before snapping

general:snap:respect_gaps.desc: if true, snapping will respect gaps between windows

general:snap:window_gap.desc: minimum gap in pixels between windows before snapping

gestures:close_max_timeout.desc: Timeout for closing windows with the close gesture, in ms.

gestures:scrolling:move_snap_cursor.desc: When releasing the scroll move gesture, whether it shoud snap the cursor to the newly focused window.

gestures:scrolling:move_snap_to_grid.desc: When releasing the scroll move gesture, whether it shoud try to snap to the grid.

gestures:workspace_swipe_cancel_ratio.desc: how much the swipe has to proceed in order to commence it.

gestures:workspace_swipe_create_new.desc: whether a swipe right on the last workspace should create a new one.

gestures:workspace_swipe_direction_lock.desc: if enabled, switching direction will be locked when you swipe past the direction_lock_threshold.

gestures:workspace_swipe_direction_lock_.desc: in px, the distance to swipe before direction lock activates.

gestures:workspace_swipe_distance.desc: in px, the distance of the touchpad gesture

gestures:workspace_swipe_forever.desc: if enabled, swiping will not clamp at the neighboring workspaces but continue to the further ones.

gestures:workspace_swipe_min_speed_to_fo.desc: minimum speed in px per timepoint to force the change ignoring cancel_ratio.

gestures:workspace_swipe_touch.desc: enable workspace swiping from the edge of a touchscreen

gestures:workspace_swipe_use_r.desc: if enabled, swiping will use the r prefix instead of the m prefix for finding workspaces.

group:drag_into_group.desc: whether dragging a window into a unlocked group will merge them.
enum: only when dragging into the groupbar

group:focus_removed_window.desc: whether Hyprland should focus on the window that has just been moved out of the group

group:group_on_movetoworkspace.desc: whether using movetoworkspace[silent] will merge the window into the workspace's solitary unlocked group

group:groupbar:col.inactive.desc: inactive (out of focus) group border color

group:groupbar:disable_when_only.desc: disable if contains single window. Considered only if enabled == true

group:groupbar:font_family.desc: font used to display groupbar titles

group:groupbar:font_weight_active.desc: weight of the font used to display active groupbar titles

group:groupbar:font_weight_inactive.desc: weight of the font used to display inactive groupbar titles

group:groupbar:gradient_round_only_edges.desc: if yes, will only round at the groupbar gradient edges

group:groupbar:gradient_rounding.desc: how much to round the groupbar gradient

group:groupbar:gradient_rounding_power.desc: rounding power of groupbar gradient corners (2 is a circle)

group:groupbar:indicator_gap.desc: height of the gap between the groupbar indicator and title

group:groupbar:keep_upper_gap.desc: keep an upper gap above gradient

group:groupbar:middle_click_close.desc: whether middle clicking the groupbar closes the clicked window

group:groupbar:priority.desc: sets the decoration priority for groupbars

group:groupbar:render_titles.desc: whether to render titles in the group bar decoration

group:groupbar:round_only_edges.desc: if yes, will only round at the groupbar edges

group:groupbar:rounding.desc: how much to round the groupbar

group:groupbar:rounding_power.desc: rounding power of groupbar corners (2 is a circle)

group:groupbar:scrolling.desc: whether scrolling in the groupbar changes group active window

group:groupbar:stacked.desc: render the groupbar as a vertical stack

group:groupbar:text_color.desc: color for window titles in the groupbar

group:groupbar:text_color_inactive.desc: color for inactive windows' titles in the groupbar

group:groupbar:text_color_locked_active.desc: color for the active window's title in a locked group

group:groupbar:text_color_locked_inactiv.desc: color for inactive windows' titles in locked groups

group:groupbar:text_offset.desc: set an offset for a text

group:groupbar:text_padding.desc: set horizontal padding for a text

group:insert_after_current.desc: whether new windows in a group spawn after current or at group tail

group:merge_floated_into_tiled_on_groupb.desc: whether dragging a floating window into a tiled window groupbar will merge them

group:merge_groups_on_drag.desc: whether window groups can be dragged into other groups

group:merge_groups_on_groupbar.desc: whether one group will be merged with another when dragged into its groupbar

input-capture:capture_modifiers.desc: If enabled, modifiers are also captured and sent to the program

input-capture:enforce_barriers.desc: If enabled, throw a wayland error when a invalid barrier is received

input:emulate_discrete_scroll.desc: Emulates discrete scrolling from high resolution scrolling events.

input:float_switch_override_focus.desc: If enabled (1 or 2), focus will change to the window under the cursor when changing from tiled-to-floating and vice versa. If 2, focus will also follow mouse on float-to-float switches.

input:focus_on_close.desc: Controls the window focus behavior when a window is closed.

input:follow_mouse.desc: Specify if and how cursor movement should affect window focus.

input:follow_mouse_shrink.desc: Shrinks the inactive window hitboxes used for focus detection by the specified number of pixels. This creates a dead zone in gaps between windows where moving the cursor will not change focus. Works only with follow_mouse = 1.

input:follow_mouse_threshold.desc: The smallest distance in logical pixels the mouse needs to travel for the window under it to get focused.

input:mouse_refocus.desc: if disabled, mouse focus won't switch to the hovered window unless the mouse crosses a window boundary when follow_mouse=1.

input:off_window_axis_events.desc: How to handle axis events around a focused window.

input:repeat_delay.desc: Delay before a held-down key is repeated, in milliseconds.

input:repeat_rate.desc: The repeat rate for held-down keys, in repeats per second.

input:resolve_binds_by_sym.desc: Determines how keybinds act when multiple layouts are used.

input:rotation.desc: Sets the rotation of a device in degrees clockwise. Value is clamped to the range 0 to 359.

input:scroll_button.desc: Sets the scroll button. 0 means default.

input:scroll_button_lock.desc: If the scroll button lock is enabled, the button does not need to be held down.

input:scroll_factor.desc: Multiplier added to scroll movement for external mice.

input:scroll_points.desc: Sets the scroll acceleration profile, when accel_profile is set to custom.

input:sensitivity.desc: Sets the mouse input sensitivity. Value is clamped to the range -1.0 to 1.0.

input:special_fallthrough.desc: if enabled, having only floating windows in the special workspace will not block focusing windows in the regular workspace.

input:tablet:absolute_region_position.desc: whether to treat the region_position as an absolute position in monitor layout.

input:tablet:active_area_position.desc: position of the active area in mm

input:tablet:active_area_size.desc: size of tablet's active area in mm

input:tablet:left_handed.desc: if enabled, the tablet will be rotated 180 degrees

input:tablet:region_position.desc: position of the mapped region in monitor layout.

input:tablet:relative_input.desc: whether the input should be relative

input:tablettool:eraser_button_mode.desc: Change the eraser button behavior on the tool. When set to 0, use the default hardware behavior of the tool. When set to 1, the eraser button on the tool sends a button event instead.

input:tablettool:eraser_button_override.desc: Set a button to be button event when eraser_button_mode is set to 1. Has to be an int, cannot be a string. Must be a valid button (e.g. BTN_STYLUS) excluding fake buttons (e.g. BTN_TOOL_*) and keys (KEY_*). Check wev if you have any doubts regarding the ID. 0 means default.

input:tablettool:pressure_range_max.desc: Set the maximum pressure range for the tool, a negative number will set the default maximum pressure value. This is usually 1.0

input:tablettool:pressure_range_min.desc: Set the minimum pressure range for the tool, a negative number will set the default minimum pressure value. This is usually 0.0

input:touchdevice:enabled.desc: Whether input is enabled for touch devices.

input:touchdevice:output.desc: The monitor to bind touch devices.

input:touchpad:clickfinger_behavior.desc: Button presses with 1, 2, or 3 fingers will be mapped to LMB, RMB, and MMB respectively.

input:touchpad:drag_3fg.desc: Whether to use 3 or 4 finger drag.

input:touchpad:drag_lock.desc: When enabled, lifting the finger off while dragging will not drop the dragged item.

input:touchpad:flip_x.desc: Inverts the horizontal movement of the touchpad

input:touchpad:flip_y.desc: Inverts the vertical movement of the touchpad

input:touchpad:middle_button_emulation.desc: Sending LMB and RMB simultaneously will be interpreted as a middle click.

input:touchpad:scroll_factor.desc: Multiplier applied to the amount of scroll movement.

input:touchpad:tap-and-drag.desc: Sets the tap and drag mode for the touchpad

input:touchpad:tap-to-click.desc: Tapping on the touchpad with 1, 2, or 3 fingers will send LMB, RMB, and MMB respectively.

input:touchpad:tap_button_map.desc: Sets the tap button mapping for touchpad button emulation. [lrm/lmr]

input:virtualkeyboard:release_pressed_on.desc: Release all pressed keys by virtual keyboard on close.

input:virtualkeyboard:share_states.desc: Unify key down states and modifier states with other keyboards.

layout:single_window_aspect_ratio.desc: If specified, whenever only a single window is open, it will be coerced into the specified aspect ratio.

layout:single_window_aspect_ratio_tolera.desc: Minimum distance for single_window_aspect_ratio to take effect.

master:allow_small_split.desc: enable adding additional master windows in a horizontal split style

master:always_keep_position.desc: whether to keep the master window in its configured position when there are no slave windows

master:center_ignores_reserved.desc: centers the master window on monitor ignoring reserved areas

master:center_master_fallback.desc: Set fallback for center master when slaves are less than slave_count_for_center_master

master:drop_at_cursor.desc: when enabled, dragging and dropping windows will put them at the cursor position.

master:focus_master_on_close.desc: when enabled, closing a window focuses the master window

master:mfact.desc: the size as a percentage of the master window.

master:new_on_active.desc: `before`, `after`: place new window relative to the focused window; `none`: place new window according to new_on_top.

master:new_on_top.desc: whether a newly open window should be on the top of the stack

master:new_status.desc: `master`: new window becomes master; `slave`: new windows are added to slave stack; `inherit`: inherit from focused window

master:orientation.desc: default placement of the master area

master:slave_count_for_center_master.desc: when using orientation=center, make the master window centered only when at least this many slave windows are open.

master:smart_resizing.desc: if enabled, resizing direction will be determined by the mouse's position on the window.

master:special_scale_factor.desc: the scale of the special workspace windows.

misc:allow_session_lock_restore.desc: if true, will allow you to restart a lockscreen app in case it crashes.

misc:always_follow_on_dnd.desc: Will make mouse focus follow the mouse when drag and dropping.

misc:animate_manual_resizes.desc: If true, will animate manual window resizes/moves

misc:animate_mouse_windowdragging.desc: If true, will animate windows being dragged by mouse.

misc:anr_missed_pings.desc: number of missed pings before showing the ANR dialog

misc:close_special_on_empty.desc: close the special workspace if the last window is removed

misc:col.splash.desc: Changes the color of the splash text.

misc:disable_autoreload.desc: If true, the config will not reload automatically on save.

misc:disable_hyprland_guiutils_check.desc: disable the warning if hyprland-guiutils is missing

misc:disable_hyprland_logo.desc: disables the random Hyprland logo / anime girl background. :(

misc:disable_scale_notification.desc: disables notification popup when a monitor fails to set a suitable scale

misc:disable_watchdog_warning.desc: whether to disable the warning about not using start-hyprland.

misc:disable_xdg_env_checks.desc: disable the warning if XDG environment is externally managed

misc:enable_anr_dialog.desc: whether to enable the ANR (app not responding) dialog when your apps hang

misc:exit_window_retains_fullscreen.desc: if true, closing a fullscreen window makes the next focused window fullscreen

misc:focus_on_activate.desc: Whether Hyprland should focus an app that requests to be focused.

misc:font_family.desc: Set the global default font to render the text.

misc:force_default_wallpaper.desc: Force any of the 3 default wallpapers. [-1/0/1/2]

misc:initial_workspace_token_timeout.desc: the time in seconds a window has to open on its invoked workspace before the tracking token expires.

misc:initial_workspace_tracking.desc: if enabled, windows will open on the workspace they were invoked on.

misc:key_press_enables_dpms.desc: If DPMS is set to off, wake up the monitors if a key is pressed.

misc:layers_hog_keyboard_focus.desc: If true, will make keyboard-interactive layers keep their focus on mouse move.

misc:lockdead_screen_delay.desc: the delay in ms after the lockdead screen appears.

misc:middle_click_paste.desc: whether to enable middle-click-paste (aka primary selection)

misc:mouse_move_enables_dpms.desc: If DPMS is set to off, wake up the monitors if the mouse moves

misc:mouse_move_focuses_monitor.desc: Whether mouse moving into a different monitor should focus it

misc:name_vk_after_proc.desc: Name virtual keyboards after the processes that create them.

misc:on_focus_under_fullscreen.desc: if there is a fullscreen or maximized window, decide whether a tiled window requested to focus should replace it.

misc:render_unfocused_fps.desc: the maximum limit for renderunfocused windows' fps in the background

misc:session_lock_blur.desc: Enable blur for lockscreen. You probably want to enable `session_lock_xray`.

misc:session_lock_xray.desc: keep rendering workspaces below your lockscreen

misc:size_limits_tiled.desc: whether to apply minsize and maxsize rules to tiled windows

misc:splash_font_family.desc: Changes the font used to render the splash text.

misc:swallow_exception_regex.desc: The title regex to be used for windows that should not be swallowed.

misc:swallow_regex.desc: The class regex to be used for windows that should be swallowed.

misc:vrr.desc: controls the VRR (Adaptive Sync) of your monitors

opengl:nvidia_anti_flicker.desc: reduces flickering on nvidia at the cost of possible frame drops on lower-end GPUs.

quirks:skip_non_kms_dmabuf_formats.desc: Do not report dmabuf formats which cannot be imported into KMS

render:cm_auto_hdr.desc: Auto-switch to hdr mode when fullscreen app is in hdr

render:cm_enabled.desc: Enable Color Management pipelines (requires restart to fully take effect)

render:cm_sdr_eotf.desc: Default transfer function for displaying SDR apps.

render:commit_timing_enabled.desc: Enable commit timing proto. Requires restart

render:ctm_animation.desc: Whether to enable a fade animation for CTM changes.

render:expand_undersized_textures.desc: Whether to expand textures that have not yet resized to be larger.

render:fp16_sdr_tf.desc: Internal workbuffer transfer function for fp16 in SDR mode

render:icc_vcgt_enabled.desc: Enable sending VCGT ramps to KMS with ICC profiles

render:keep_unmodified_copy.desc: Keep umodified SDR frame copy for sreensharing.

render:new_render_scheduling.desc: enable new render scheduling, which should improve FPS on underpowered devices.

render:non_shader_cm_interop.desc: non_shader_cm interaction with ctm proto (hyprsunset and similar).

render:send_content_type.desc: Report content type to allow monitor profile autoswitch

render:xp_mode.desc: Disable back buffer and bottom layer rendering.

scrolling:column_width.desc: the default width of a column.

scrolling:direction.desc: Direction in which new windows appear and the layout scrolls

scrolling:explicit_column_widths.desc: A comma-separated list of preconfigured widths for colresize +conf/-conf

scrolling:focus_fit_method.desc: When a column is focused, what method should be used to bring it into view

scrolling:follow_focus.desc: when a window is focused, should the layout move to bring it into view automatically

scrolling:follow_min_visible.desc: when a window is focused, require that at least a given fraction of it is visible for focus to follow

scrolling:fullscreen_on_one_column.desc: when enabled, a single column on a workspace will always span the entire screen.

scrolling:wrap_focus.desc: Determines if column focus wraps around

scrolling:wrap_swapcol.desc: Determines if column movement wraps around

xwayland:create_abstract_socket.desc: Create the abstract Unix domain socket for XWayland

xwayland:force_zero_scaling.desc: forces a scale of 1 on xwayland windows on scaled displays.

xwayland:use_nearest_neighbor.desc: uses the nearest neighbor filtering for xwayland apps, making them pixelated rather than blurry
